title: Starting co-op four ways: player 1 keeps their device (DPC 0.9.172-dev46)
intro: Player 1 starts on the Arisen; three controllers on. Co-op off. Each step waits for End (keyboard).

probes.mode: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; if not D then return '' end; if D.coop.active then return 'classic' elseif D.R.cp and D.R.cp.on and D.R.s2 and D.R.s2.active then return D.R.cp.mode end; return 'off'
probes.p1: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local t = D and D.R.tp; if not t or not t.p1 then return 'none' end; return t.p1 == D.R.KB_ADDR and 'keyboard' or string.format('controller %X', t.p1 & 0xFFFFFF)
probes.p2: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local t = D and D.R.tp; return (t and t.p2) and string.format('%X', t.p2 & 0xFFFFFF) or 'none'
probes.wait: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.kb_wait() or false
probes.np: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.np_count and D.R.np_count() or 0
probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors

steps.text: Get ready: playing the Arisen, co-op off, all three controllers on and awake. Press End.

A. PLAYER 1 ON A CONTROLLER: walk the Arisen around for a few seconds on controller A (don't touch the keyboard or mouse). Then a friend holds L3 + R3 on controller B until co-op starts. Player 1 should keep controller A. End when co-op is on.
A. Check: controller A moves the Arisen and turns the camera, controller B only its pawn. Then PLAYER 1 holds L3 + R3 on controller A for 3 seconds to end co-op. End when done.

B. PLAYER 1 ON KEYBOARD AND MOUSE: walk the Arisen with the keyboard and turn with the mouse for a few seconds (no controller). Then a friend holds L3 + R3 on a controller. Player 1 stays on keyboard and mouse. End when co-op is on.
B. Check: no controller moves the Arisen; the friend's controller plays their pawn. PLAYER 1: Ctrl + F6 to end co-op. End when done.

C. CTRL + F6 WITH SEVERAL CONTROLLERS: press Ctrl + F6. Co-op starts waiting for player 2: no controller moves the Arisen or turns the camera. Then hold L3 + R3 on one controller (player 2), then on another (player 3). End when both are in.
C. PLAYER 1: Ctrl + F6 to end co-op. End when done.

D. (optional) CTRL + F6 WITH ONE CONTROLLER: switch two controllers off so only one is connected, leave it on the table, press Ctrl + F6. That controller should be player 2 straight away. Ctrl + F6 again to end. End when done (or straight away to skip).
Done. Tell Claude how each start felt.
